articles.summary: Celebrating Excellence in Sales, Marketing, and Home Design Green Brick Partners, Inc. (NYSE: GRBK) is proud to announce that its homebuilding brands—CB JENI Homes, Normandy Homes, and Southgate Homes—earned eight honors at the 2026 McSAM Awards. The Bella II - Normandy Homes at Painted Tree Woodland North Presented annually by the Dallas Builders Association, the McSAM Awards honor excellence in sales, marketing, and residential design across the Dallas Metroplex. articles.title: Green Brick Brands and Professionals Earn Eight Honors at 2026 McSAM Awards

articles.summary: 2026 FIRST QUARTER HIGHLIGHTS Earnings per diluted share of $1.39 and net income of $60.9 million New home deliveries of 908 Homebuilding gross margins of 28.9% Net new home orders of 1,037 Homebuilding debt to total capital of 11.5%; net homebuilding debt to total capital of 5.5% Repurchased approximately 114,000 shares of common stock for approximately $7.2 million Began sales in the Houston market Green Brick Partners, Inc. (NYSE: GRBK) (“we,” “Green Brick” or the “Company”) today reported results for its first quarter ended March 31, 2026. Net income attributable to Green Brick in the first quarter of 2026 was $60.9 million, resulting in diluted earnings per share of $1.39. The company delivered 908 homes. Net new sales orders were 1,037 for the quarter, with the monthly sales pace for the first quarter of 2026 decreasing slightly to 3.4, as compared to 3.5 in prior year period.
